title: kate-core: indent after a brace before a line comment
summary: A cstyle newline still adds one indent unit when a line comment follows a brace. A brace inside the comment does not add a unit. The test goes in the existing indent tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: indent.rs is a private module of workspace.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Change only ends_with_opener. Use this body. let code = body.split_once("//").map(|(head, _)| head).unwrap_or(body); then the existing matches! on code.trim_end_matches of space and tab. The opener scalars stay { ( and [. Do not match Option by hand. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch newline_insertion, python_newline, newline_for_indenter, indent_lines, unindent_lines, ends_with_colon, is_comment_line, is_dedent_word, or indent_unit. The test a_comment_after_a_brace_still_indents uses the existing inserted helper with cstyle true and DocumentConfig::default. The text of four spaces, foo, {, space, //, space, note returns a newline and eight spaces. The text of four spaces, foo, {, //, note returns a newline and eight spaces. The text of four spaces, foo, space, //, space, { returns a newline and four spaces. The text http:// returns a newline and no spaces. The existing cstyle_newline_adds_one_unit_after_a_brace test stays green. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: workspace::indent::tests::a_comment_after_a_brace_still_indents
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A brace before a line comment does not add an indent unit. After the change it does. A brace that sits inside the comment does not add a unit.
